definition: Hamming only defined for same-length sequences; cross-length pairs excluded
layout: per-length 2D classical MDS of Hamming distance; independent of labels; approximate, not exact geometry
measurements: norm: fluorescence/OD600, per-sequence means as supplied
permutation: 10000 label permutations within length, all high/low roles recomputed, one-sided positive-association test; Holm8
caveat: retrospective measured sample only; edge observations share nodes; significance does not prove best acquisition policy
